doc.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001

title: Closing
summary: Monk thanks Frishberg, who is eager to go play.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Good luck. Okay. I won’t quit my day gig on that though. Well I know you have to go perform.
I’m happy to go. I mean not that I haven’t enjoyed this, but let’s play already.
I appreciate your time, it’s been really a fascinating conversation.
And I’ll be listening later on tonight. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
